notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell + the real AdminDashboard (its own internal Masthead), populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-admin'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

Artboard order: Masthead -> 8-tile stat grid (Workspaces/Sources/Ingest/Coverage/Research pipeline/Community pickups/Runtime/Emission factors), Sources tile SELECTED (bordered, no shadow) -> breadcrumb strip ('Admin / <selected section>') -> Sources sub-tab bar, 'Provisional review' FIRST and active -> the provisional-review table -> Organizations section -> rail: Issues queue, Companies/Individuals/Newest join/Active this month tiles, read-only-controls note.

This lane fixed two real defects: (1) AdminDashboard defaulted to Workspaces/Organizations, not the artboard's default Sources/Provisional-review landing state — fixed by changing the initial section/sub state. (2) The Sources tab order was [Source registry, Provisional review, ...]; dc.html p13 lists Provisional review first — reordered. Also wired AdminDashboard to sync SourceHealthDashboard's own internal `activeView` (a zustand-store field the component never previously received from its caller, despite AdminDashboard's own comment claiming 'the sub-tab scopes the operator's intent') so picking 'Provisional review' actually opens SourceHealthDashboard's Provisional tab instead of always landing on Registry.

NOT FIXED, logged instead (DEVIATION-LOG 2026-09-08): SourceHealthDashboard itself — the component the Provisional-review tab renders — is a much larger, differently-composed surface than dc.html p13's simple 'SOURCES · PROVISIONAL REVIEW' table (SOURCE/TIER/STATUS/DISCOVERED columns, one Approve button per row). The shipped component renders its own 'Source Intelligence' header, a B.2 regeneration-progress bar, a Source Tiers legend block, a T1-T7 tile grid, and its own second Registry/Health/Provisional/Canonical/Intersections/Themes/Obligations tab bar — none of which the artboard shows for this region. Rebuilding SourceHealthDashboard's Provisional view to match the artboard is a component-level effort (the surface is shared beyond this one entry point) out of this page-composition pass's reach; this spec does not assert a fabricated match for that region's content, only for what the mount actually renders identically to the artboard (masthead, tile grid, tab selection/order, Organizations section, rail).
OrganizationsTable — no artboard region (fix58-account's own 2026-09-07 DEVIATION-LOG entry already established this; unaudited, left as-is, listed again here for this lane's own record).
